send_transactional_email.description: Send one email from your app, such as a receipt or login code, to up to 10 people. Needs transactional access in SendFox.
send_transactional_email.name: send_transactional_email

parameters.description: An address on a domain verified in SendFox, optionally with a name: Acme <hello@mail.acme.com>. onboarding@sendfoxmail.com works without a domain, but only reaches your own account email.
parameters.name: from_address

parameters.description: 1 to 10 addresses. Every address counts as one send.
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: The subject line.
parameters.name: subject

parameters.description: The email as HTML. Give this, a plain-text body, or both.
parameters.name: html

parameters.description: The email as plain text. Give this, an HTML body, or both.
parameters.name: text

parameters.description: Addresses to copy. To, Cc and Bcc together hold at most 10.
parameters.name: cc

parameters.description: At most 2 hidden addresses.
parameters.name: bcc

parameters.description: Where replies go, if not to the From address.
parameters.name: reply_to

parameters.description: A label for this kind of email, such as receipt: lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
parameters.name: tag

parameters.description: Extra headers such as List-Unsubscribe or X-Entity-Ref-ID.
parameters.name: headers

parameters.description: Any unique text, such as an order id. SendFox sends one email per key, so a re-run step does not send twice. One is made if empty.
parameters.name: idempotency_key

idempotency_key.description: The idempotency key the email was sent with

replayed.description: True when the key was used before and nothing new was sent

sends_remaining.description: Sends left this month; empty when there is no cap

tag_contact.description: Apply an existing tag to a contact. Applying it again changes nothing. Returns the contact's tags.
tag_contact.name: tag_contact

parameters.description: The contact's id, from 'Create contact' or an earlier step.
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.description: The contact tag. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: tag_id

count.description: How many tags the contact has

description: Grow your SendFox audience: create contacts, add them to lists and tag them, read campaigns and their stats, automations and forms, and send transactional email.
